citadel.speaker: Narrator
citadel.text: At the gates of the x86 Citadel, an old software banner still flies.

intel.speaker: Intel
intel.text: The old code stays. Compatibility is the gate.

amd.speaker: AMD
amd.text: Then I'll build around it. A chiplet bridge could do more than a wall.

choice.speaker: Narrator
choice.text: The architects must choose what to prioritize.

legacy.speaker: Intel
legacy.text: We keep yesterday's applications alive. The citadel opens slowly, but safely.

bridge.speaker: AMD
bridge.text: A modular bridge goes up beside the gate. New pieces can now join the design.

legacy_end.speaker: Narrator
legacy_end.text: ENDING: The Compatibility Pact. Old programs remain the kingdom's first promise.

bridge_end.speaker: Narrator
bridge_end.text: ENDING: The Chiplet Accord. The factions agree to collaborate on a new architecture.
